correctness.rationale: For every field and n>=2 the recursive images are forced by e_(j+1)=e_j^2. A single targeted coefficient a_t a_s^(2^(t-s)) detects every forbidden pair of nonterminal nonzero entries; one nonterminal entry suffices. The reduced radical ideal equality follows from square-free monomial ideal containment and these powers. Rank and composition nilpotency follow from support shifts. Eleven independent finite-field configurations including exhaustive all-linear-map tests and direct composition verify examples; no finite-test inference is used in the proof.

value.rationale: The chain algebra has extremal nilpotency growth, so its endomorphism monoid is a natural structural invariant. The theorem gives a complete unrestricted monoid parametrization in every dimension and characteristic, identifies distinct geometric components, exact finite-field ranks, and a rigid dichotomy that all nonunits are composition-nilpotent. These invariants cannot be read off solely from the known automorphism group and distinguish genuinely different morphism strata.
